details.label: Extended Outlook
details.text: Tuesday through Sunday. There is a potential for severe thunderstorms Tuesday afternoon and evening, with damaging wind and large hail the main hazards. Additional chances for severe storms are possible at times from late Wednesday into Thursday as a cold front drifts south across the region. Main hazards are damaging wind and hail with a possibility for a tornado. In addition, hot and humid conditions are expected by Tuesday, peaking on Wednesday. Heat indices in the mid to upper 90s are possible outside of the higher terrain areas, however, some showers and cloud cover could limit daytime heating on Tuesday.
